name: Community — Iris-3B
author: Speridlabs
description: Iris-3B by Speridlabs: a small (3B) text-to-image model that paints pixels directly, with no VAE. Two cards: the base model (50 steps, about 35 s a picture on a 12 GB card) and the official 4-step Turbo (about 10 s a picture). Both render at about 1 megapixel and share the Qwen3VL 4B text encoder the Krea 2 cards already use, so the base card adds only a 3.4 GB download. Runs through the ComfyUI-Iris pack by Nynxz, which the app installs for you. The base card's file is INT8 and needs an RTX 20-series card or newer. Apache-2.0.

presets.name: Iris-3B
presets.tagline: Small pixel-space model, no VAE, about 35 s a picture
presets.description: The base Iris-3B model (INT8 build, 3.4 GB). It generates the picture directly in pixels, so there is no VAE softening fine detail. 50 steps at CFG 3 is the default; raise Steps toward 100 for the model card's reference quality, or lower it to 30 for speed. Stay near 1 megapixel: the model was tuned there and draws a visible grid at small sizes. Leave the negative prompt empty unless you need it. Prompts are plain descriptive English, up to about 295 tokens.

requirements.notes: Iris-3B DiT (diffusion_models): nynxz/iris-3b @ 1a49f7b4, iris-3b_int8_convrot.safetensors, 3,352,481,056 B, SHA256 6ec133c4905048acadd1062dfd393f9893292071134498e1a1333d0093a95686 (Nynxz's INT8 ConvRot quantization of the Speridlabs release; needs an RTX 20-series or newer for INT8 tensor cores) + Qwen3VL 4B encoder shared with the Krea 2 cards (loaded as type krea2, the same 12-layer setup Iris trained on). No VAE: Load VAE 'pixel_space' is a built-in pass-through. res_multistep / simple, 50 steps, CFG 3, ModelSamplingSD3 shift 4, empty negative encoded as text (not zeroed). Needs the ComfyUI-Iris extension (Nynxz, Apache-2.0, no Python requirements, adds no nodes: it registers Iris with ComfyUI's own loaders) and ComfyUI 0.38 or newer. Tested 2026-10-12 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB (plain ComfyUI 0.39, direct submission): 3 prompts x 3 seeds at 1024x1024, 1.85 it/s, 27 s sampling, about 8.6 GB VRAM in use. Verified in the app 2026-10-12 (SimpliGen 1.73.2, engine 0.38.0, hand-installed copy): the app downloaded the model and installed ComfyUI-Iris at the pinned commit itself; 3 renders (864x1152 and 1344x768 at 50 steps, 1024x1024 at 30 steps) finished in 21-39 s, with checkpoint, size, seed, steps, CFG and sampler read back from the engine. LoRAs not tested. Model licence: Apache-2.0 (Speridlabs).

extensions.name: ComfyUI-Iris
extensions.description: Registers the Iris-3B model with ComfyUI's stock loaders (adds no nodes)

presets.name: Iris-3B Turbo
presets.tagline: The official 4-step distill, about 10 s a picture
presets.description: Speridlabs' own 4-step Turbo distill of Iris-3B (a full fine-tune, 6 GB). Guidance is baked in, so there is no Steps or CFG slider and the negative prompt is not used: the four-step schedule is part of the model. Layouts follow the base card closely for the same seed, which makes it a fast way to try prompts before a 50-step render. The sizes offered are the ones Turbo was distilled at.

requirements.notes: Iris-3B Turbo DiT (diffusion_models): speridlabs/iris-3b @ adc05b90, turbo/model.safetensors saved as iris-3b-turbo_bf16.safetensors, 5,975,089,200 B (bf16), SHA256 7148dbba3117567e34c86fadaae6e10325feb2c0ff3f43fe4938c15c75b356e1 + Qwen3VL 4B encoder shared with the Krea 2 cards (type krea2). No VAE (pixel_space pass-through). Sampling: BasicGuider (no CFG, no negative), euler, ManualSigmas 1.0, 0.938, 0.833, 0.625, 0.0, the released schedule from turbo/distill.yaml (final sigmas, equal to quarter steps at shift 5). Sizes are the seven distillation buckets: 1024x1024, 752x1344, 896x1344, 896x1200 and their transposes. Needs the ComfyUI-Iris extension (Nynxz) and ComfyUI 0.38 or newer. Tested 2026-10-12 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB (plain ComfyUI 0.39, direct submission): 3 prompts x 3 seeds at 1024x1024, about 2 s sampling. Verified in the app 2026-10-12 (SimpliGen 1.73.2, engine 0.38.0, hand-installed copy): the app downloaded the file under its manifest name (sha256 matched); 3 renders (752x1344, 1344x896, 1024x1024) each executed in 10-12 s including model load, with checkpoint, size, seed and schedule read back from the engine. LoRAs not tested. Model licence: Apache-2.0 (Speridlabs).
